messages:
devon: Hi all, Devon here — first day! Getting stuck on SSO: the Okta activation link asks me to enroll a security key but I don't have one. The page won't let me use Okta Verify or SMS, just 'Security Key (U2F)'. Anyone know what's up?
it-help: Welcome Devon :wave: That sounds like a policy misconfiguration. Can you paste the exact text on the Okta page?
devon: It says: 'Your organization requires a hardware security key. Insert your key or select another method' and the only option is 'Enroll security key'. No 'Choose another factor' link.
it-bot: Okta provisioning check for devon@redwood.ai started (job 1762612342)
people-ops: We don't require hardware keys for all hires. It should allow Okta Verify or SMS. Tagging @mfa-admin to check the policy.
mfa-admin: Looking now. It appears Devon's account was placed into the developer-sudo group by mistake which has a strict MFA policy (security key only). I'll remove that group membership — give me 2 min.
leo: FYI, devs in infra sometimes get that group for key access, but it's not standard for new hires.
it-help: Removed developer-sudo group from devon@redwood.ai and retriggered enrollment link. You should get a fresh activation link in your inbox in a minute.
it-bot: Okta group update logged by mfa-admin at 2026-03-24T09:15:12Z
devon: I got the new link. Now it shows "Okta Verify" and "SMS". I'll enroll with Okta Verify.
it-help: Great — enroll Okta Verify, then test a sign-in. If SMS is easier, you can opt for that too.
devon: Enrolled Okta Verify and signed in. One more odd thing: I don't have access to Google Drive or the eng Slack channels yet. My Google mailbox exists but I can't open internal docs.
sam: Sometimes the Google group mapping comes later. Can you try opening an internal doc link and share the error?
devon: Error dialog: "You need permission" when opening product/roadmap doc. It shows my account as devon@redwood.ai.
it-help: Looks like the Google groups sync didn't add you to 'eng-all' and 'prod-read'. I'll manually add you to the groups now.
it-bot: Manual Google group add requested for devon@redwood.ai by it-help
people-ops: Also, 1Password invite sent earlier today to devon+work@gmail.com (we sometimes had legacy invites to alt emails). I'll resend to devon@redwood.ai. Check spam if you don't see it.
devon: I did have an invite at the alt address, but I prefer corporate one. Thanks for resending.
it-help: Resent 1Password invite to devon@redwood.ai and added you to eng-all and prod-read groups. Please retry the doc.
devon: Docs open now, and I accepted 1Password invite. All good. Thank you everyone for the quick turnaround!
leo: Welcome aboard :tada: Also opened a quick ticket to check why new hires are sometimes put into developer-sudo by default in the provisioning flow.
mfa-admin: Filed as INFRA-2147. We'll audit the provisioning role rules and add a guardrail to prevent group leakage.
devon: Appreciate it. Happy to test anything for the ticket.
